title: CanoPie: A Graphical User Interface for Multitemporal Canopy Imagery Data Analysis
description: CanoPie is a free, open-source desktop application (Python, PyQt5) for loading, annotating, editing and measuring multitemporal canopy imagery -- raw drone frames, orthomosaics (including Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs) and phenocam images -- following individual tree crowns through time without photogrammetry. It ships as a standalone Windows app.
